text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Hishi Amazon came to an amusement 
park together with the Miho Dorm students.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, wanna hit the haunted house next? 
I hear real ghosts actually show up here♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'll watch the luggage. You guys go 
ahead and enjoy yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, having Big Sis Hishi watch our 
bags... We'd feel awful making you do 
that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was just about to take a break 
anyway! Don't worry about it! Go on, off 
you go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, good grief. I could hardly admit 
that I'm afraid of ghosts, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You can't even have a one-on-one fistfight 
with a ghost... Ugh, just thinking about 
it gives me the chills...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the ghosts she dreaded so 
much, Hishi Amazon ended up falling out of 
shape.
